moments.title: I'm A Celeb Returns!
moments.blurb: Ant & Dec are back in the jungle as 'I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here!' kicks off its new series on ITV1 on Monday, November 16th at 9pm.

angles.name: Launch Night Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready for Bushtucker Trials and celebrity drama! I'm A Celeb is back on Monday night. Who are you hoping to see in the jungle?

angles.name: Ant & Dec are back
angles.copy: The kings of the jungle are returning! Ant & Dec are ready for another series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! starting Monday. Are you?

moments.title: Strictly Heads to Blackpool!
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is preparing for its iconic Blackpool Week, set to air on Saturday, November 21st, as the competition heats up towards the semi-finals.

angles.name: Ballroom by the Beach
angles.copy: Glitter, glamour, and the Tower Ballroom! Strictly Come Dancing is off to Blackpool this Saturday. Who's your favourite couple to watch?

angles.name: Blackpool Magic
angles.copy: It's the most anticipated week in the Strictly calendar! Blackpool Week arrives this Saturday. Will your favourites shine under the famous lights?

moments.title: Black Friday Approaches
moments.blurb: Retailers across the UK are gearing up for Black Friday 2026, officially on November 27th, with many deals expected to start from Monday, November 23rd.

angles.name: Deal Hunting Begins
angles.copy: Black Friday deals are just around the corner, with many starting next week! What's on your shopping list this year?

angles.name: Get Ready to Save
angles.copy: The biggest shopping event of the year is almost here! Black Friday officially lands on November 27th, but expect early bird deals from Monday. Are you ready?

moments.title: Christmas Markets Open Across UK
moments.blurb: Festive cheer is spreading as major Christmas markets in Cardiff, York, Leicester, Canterbury, and London (Covent Garden, Old Spitalfields Market) open their doors this week, joining those already open in Birmingham and Manchester.

angles.name: Festive Fun Begins
angles.copy: Mulled wine and twinkling lights! Christmas Markets are opening across the UK this week, from Cardiff to York and London. Where are you heading for some festive magic?

angles.name: Local Christmas Cheer
angles.copy: Cardiff Christmas Market opens tomorrow, November 12th! Get ready for handmade crafts and festive treats in the city centre. Who's excited?

angles.name: London's Winter Wonderland
angles.copy: London's Christmas Markets are in full swing or opening this week, including Covent Garden and Old Spitalfields Market today! Time to get your festive fix.

moments.title: Exeter Christmas Market Opens
moments.blurb: The Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market returns to Cathedral Green from Friday, November 13th, featuring over 100 festive chalets and a new tipi bar.

angles.name: Exeter Gets Festive
angles.copy: Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market opens this Friday! Get ready for festive stalls, local crafts, and a brand new tipi bar on Cathedral Green. Who's joining the fun?

angles.name: Shop Local in Devon
angles.copy: Support local makers and soak up the festive atmosphere! Exeter Christmas Market starts Friday, November 13th. Perfect for unique gifts and seasonal treats.

moments.title: Premier League Returns
moments.blurb: The Premier League is back with a packed schedule this weekend, including Manchester City vs Fulham and Chelsea vs Leeds on Saturday, November 21st, and a big clash between Liverpool and Manchester United on Sunday, November 22nd.

angles.name: Football Feast
angles.copy: Premier League action returns this weekend! Who are you tipping for victory in the big clashes like Liverpool vs Man Utd on Sunday?

angles.name: Weekend Blockbusters
angles.copy: Massive games coming up in the Premier League! Get ready for Chelsea vs Leeds, Newcastle vs Arsenal, and the huge North West Derby. What's your match of the weekend?

moments.title: Championship Action
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship delivers another weekend of thrilling football on November 21st and 22nd, with fixtures including Millwall vs QPR and Burnley vs Blackburn Rovers.

angles.name: EFL Excitement
angles.copy: It's a big weekend in the Championship! Who are you backing in the key clashes on Saturday and Sunday?

angles.name: Welsh Derbies?
angles.copy: Big weekend for Welsh clubs in the Championship! Keep an eye on the results as the battle for promotion heats up.

moments.title: UK Chart Update: Jamie Miller Still #1
moments.blurb: Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' holds the UK Official Singles Chart Number 1 spot for an eleventh week, while Queens of the Stone Age top the albums chart with 'Perfecth'. Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' re-enters the top 5.

angles.name: Chart Reign Continues
angles.copy: Still at Number 1! Jamie Miller's 'Babydoll' is dominating the UK Singles Chart for an incredible eleventh week. What's your favourite track right now?

angles.name: Thriller's Resurgence
angles.copy: Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' is back in the Official Singles Chart Top 5, reaching a new all-time peak! A Halloween classic still making waves. What's your favourite MJ track?

angles.name: Rock Reigns Supreme
angles.copy: New album chart topper! Queens of the Stone Age's 'Perfecth' is #1 on the Official Albums Chart. What's your top rock album right now?

moments.title: Happy 66th to Kim Wilde
moments.blurb: Pop icon Kim Wilde celebrates her 66th birthday on November 18th. The 'Kids in America' singer has had a career spanning decades.

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to the incredible Kim Wilde today! What's your favourite of her classic hits?

angles.name: Still Rockin'
angles.copy: From 'Kids in America' to 'You Came', Kim Wilde has always been a pop sensation. Happy 66th birthday to the legend!

moments.title: Kirk Hammett Turns 64
moments.blurb: Metallica's lead guitarist Kirk Hammett celebrates his 64th birthday on November 18th. He's been a driving force behind one of the biggest metal bands in history.

angles.name: Metal God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 64th birthday to the legendary Kirk Hammett of Metallica! What's your favourite Metallica riff he's shredded?

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: 64 today! Kirk Hammett's iconic solos have defined generations of rock music. Celebrate the Metallica guitarist's birthday with your favourite track!

moments.title: Björk Turns 61
moments.blurb: The visionary Icelandic artist Björk celebrates her 61st birthday on November 21st. Known for her unique sound and innovative visuals.

angles.name: Iconic Innovator
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Björk! Her music continues to inspire and push boundaries. What's your favourite Björk track?

angles.name: Unique Sound
angles.copy: Celebrating 61 years of groundbreaking music! Björk's influence on pop and electronic music is undeniable. Send her your birthday wishes!

moments.title: Alex James is 58
moments.blurb: Blur bassist and cheesemaker Alex James celebrates his 58th birthday on November 21st. A key figure in Britpop and beyond.

angles.name: Britpop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 58th birthday to Blur's very own Alex James! From basslines to cheesemaking, he's a true original. What's your favourite Blur song?

angles.name: More Than Music
angles.copy: Celebrating Alex James' 58th today! The Blur bassist and cultural icon has had quite the career. What's your favourite Britpop memory?

moments.title: Travis Barker Turns 51
moments.blurb: Blink-182 drummer Travis Barker celebrates his 51st birthday on November 14th. A punk rock drumming legend and producer.

angles.name: Punk Rock Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 51st birthday to the incredible Travis Barker! From Blink-182 to his collaborations, his drumming is legendary. What's your favourite track featuring Travis?

angles.name: Still Drumming On
angles.copy: 51 today! Travis Barker continues to be one of the most influential drummers in rock. Celebrate his birthday with some classic Blink-182!

moments.title: Chad Kroeger is 52

angles.name: Rock Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 52nd birthday to Nickelback's Chad Kroeger! What's your go-to Nickelback anthem?

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: Celebrating 52 years of Chad Kroeger! The Nickelback frontman has given us some massive rock hits. What's your favourite?

moments.title: Frida Lyngstad Turns 81
moments.blurb: Anni-Frid 'Frida' Lyngstad of ABBA celebrates her 81st birthday on November 15th. A pop legend and one quarter of the iconic Swedish group.

angles.name: Dancing Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to ABBA's legendary Frida Lyngstad! What's your favourite ABBA track to dance along to?

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible Frida Lyngstad of ABBA, who turns 81 today! Her voice helped define a generation. What's your top ABBA song?

moments.blurb: Grammy and Oscar-winning musician Jon Batiste celebrates his 40th birthday today, November 11th.

angles.name: Celebrating a Musical Talent
angles.copy: Happy 40th birthday to the incredibly talented Jon Batiste! What's your favourite piece of his incredible work?

angles.name: Jazz & Beyond
angles.copy: Turning 40 today, Jon Batiste is a true musical force. Wishing him a fantastic birthday!

angles.name: Supermodel Birthday
angles.copy: You better werk! Happy 66th birthday to the one and only RuPaul! What's your favourite RuPaul track or moment?

angles.name: Drag Royalty
angles.copy: Celebrating the iconic RuPaul, who turns 66 today! An absolute legend in music, TV, and culture.
